answer: The performer from Night Rocker is **David Hasselhoff**, who appeared on Young and Restless as **Dr. Snapper Foster** (full name: Dr. William "Snapper" Foster Jr.). He portrayed this character during two periods: primarily from 1975 to 1982, and briefly reprised the role in 2010. This was one of Hasselhoff's earliest major television appearances, before he became famous for his roles in Knight Rider and Baywatch, and his work with Night Rocker in the mid-to-late 1980s.
